_note: Layer 2 of the three-layer model: owner/account state, never product facts. Fields set to null are collected at onboarding — the engine must refuse to score a rule whose ownerCondition is unresolved rather than guess.

switchThreshold._note: Recommend leaving the default card only when net advantage clears BOTH floors. Dossier §4 said 'or'; 'both' implemented as the safer reading (an 'or' lets a 0.1pp edge trigger a switch on any large purchase) — flagged for Zubair's veto. Acceptance constraints always override (e.g., Mastercard-only Costco).
